items.title: Al Gafa interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 2, 2023
items.q: And the guys that I started working for was this Doc Pomus and Morty Shuman

ctx.x: Those first sessions, like that first audition, did they put music in front of you? Chord charts or what?

At the audition it was a group auditioning for them when the music had been rehearsed and all, and so that part was done. But when we were in the studio it was mostly chord charts, yes. And I need to tell you about the — these were demos. The business at that time was that writers would write a song and then they would go in the studio and record it and make this demonstration record and then mail these demonstration records out to the various artists. We would go through the publishing company and mail it out.…
Did the demos ever become the actual record?
